parts:
Try something like this.

ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  #
  sidebarPanel(
    h4("...")
  ),
  # 
  mainPanel(
    aceEditor("text", 
              value="", 
              mode="r", theme="cobalt"),
    tableOutput("dataframe")
  )
))

server.R 
library(shiny)
library(shinyAce)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  get.text <- reactive({
    input$text
  })  
  output$dataframe <- renderTable({
    read.table(get.text())
  })
})

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: How to create a data frame from text submitted in a textarea
parts: The contents of the text area is sent to R as a character string. So your question has nothing to do with shinyAce: you are asking how to convert a table given as a character string to a matrix. In my example, I convert this character string to a dataframe with the read.table() function. Then you can convert this dataframe with the as.matrix() function if you want.

parts:
Alternatively you would copy the data into your app from the clipboard:

    os_type <- .Platform$OS.type
    if (os_type == 'windows') {
      
      dat <- try(read.table("clipboard", header = TRUE, sep = '\t'), silent = TRUE)
      if(is(dat, 'try-error')) dat <- c("Data from clipboard was not well formatted. Try exporting the data to csv format.")
    } else { 

      dat <- try(read.table(pipe("pbpaste"), header = TRUE, sep = '\t'), silent = TRUE)
      if(is(dat, 'try-error')) dat <- c("Data from clipboard was not well formatted. Try exporting the data to csv format.")
    }

Take a look at https://github.com/mostly-harmless/radyant to see it in action.
